newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Zipporah to develop Makati property.
newsitem.headline: Zipporah to develop Makati property.

text.p: Philippines' Zipporah Mining and Industrial Corp said on Wednesday its board had agreed to negotiate with a local real estate company to develop a 2,400 square metre property in Manila's Makati business district.
Zipporah told the Philippine Stock Exchange that it had authorised its officers to negotiate with Sta Lucia Realty & Development Corp for the terms and conditions of the joint venture.
The company also said that it had decided to opt for a share swap with Ebedev Corp, a company owned by banker Edgardo Espiritu, instead of a property-for-share swap as earlier agreed upon.
It did not give any reason for the change in acquisition strategy. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
